stories.title: White House walks back Trump's 'let 'em take out LA' remark
stories.summary: After Trump told a Nebraska rally that Iran could 'take out Los Angeles' and 'take out San Diego' as 'a very small price to pay' for the war, an aide said the president was explaining how he is preventing such an attack rather than inviting one. California Gov. Gavin Newsom called the comments 'deranged and dangerous', and Trump also said his MAGA Inc. super PAC would pay for taxpayer-funded ads promoting him.

stories.title: Russia says nearly 900 Ukrainian drones were downed overnight
stories.summary: Moscow's defense ministry said air defenses intercepted around 900 Ukrainian drones over Russia, occupied Crimea and the Sea of Azov, while officials in the Moscow region reported two deaths and unconfirmed reports of a burning fuel depot. President Zelenskyy said Kyiv has fresh intelligence on a coming 'massive' Russian strike and is preparing countermeasures.

stories.title: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces push to retake the Red Sea coast
stories.summary: Government forces say they recaptured the port city of Mokha and seized ground around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait in a lightning counteroffensive, though the Houthis deny losing territory. Saudi Arabia confirmed Houthi strikes damaged Jizan and Najran airports, and Brent crude held near $100 a barrel as traders watched the shipping route.

stories.title: Neutrino hunter Francis Halzen wins the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics
stories.summary: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the physics Nobel to Francis Halzen of the University of Wisconsin for 'decisive contributions' to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin. The prize recognizes a detector built inside a cubic kilometre of Antarctic ice.

stories.title: DeepSeek set to raise more than $12 billion ahead of a 2027 IPO
stories.summary: The Chinese AI developer is closing a round worth over 80 billion yuan (about $11.9 billion) led by Tencent and battery maker CATL, Reuters reported, with the total possibly reaching $15 billion. The cash would fund a buildout that includes 160,000 Huawei AI chips at a new data center in Inner Mongolia.

stories.title: Vinci raises $250M at a $1.5B valuation for engineering-simulation AI
stories.summary: The Palo Alto startup said it raised $250 million at a $1.5 billion valuation to expand AI-driven software that simulates chip and hardware design before anything is built. It is part of a funding wave aimed at cutting the cost of physical prototyping.

stories.title: OpenAI outlines 'textGrain' watermarking for ChatGPT text in the EU
stories.summary: OpenAI detailed how it will make generated text machine-readable to satisfy the EU AI Act, including invisible marks in eligible ChatGPT and Codex output plus an opt-in watermark for API customers. The company warns the marks are easy to weaken with editing and that detection remains unreliable.

stories.title: Browns not looking to trade Shedeur Sanders, insider says
stories.summary: Cleveland reporter Daryl Ruiter reversed his own prediction and said the Browns want to keep developing Shedeur Sanders behind Deshaun Watson rather than move him before the November 10 deadline. ESPN's Jeremy Fowler still sees the team as willing to listen if the right offer arrives for Sanders or Dillon Gabriel.

stories.title: 3-1 Browns head to New York as underdogs against the Jets
stories.summary: Cleveland rides a three-game win streak into Sunday's game at MetLife Stadium, yet is a small underdog against a Jets team that has lost three straight. The Browns' offensive line is banged up, with Teven Jenkins and Elgton Jenkins both questionable, while Mason Graham is listed questionable with knee and ankle injuries.

stories.title: Khalil Mack trade math: what an edge rusher would cost Cleveland
stories.summary: With Alex Wright out for the season, the Browns are among the teams linked to Chargers edge rusher Khalil Mack, who has three sacks in four games for a 0-4 team. Because Los Angeles already paid his signing bonus, a deal this week would cost Cleveland just over $6 million in cap space, dropping by about $1 million every two weeks.

stories.title: Browns defensive line takes hits: Mason Graham sprains MCL
stories.summary: Rookie defensive tackle Mason Graham suffered a grade 2 MCL sprain and a grade 1 ankle sprain against Pittsburgh, while Michael Hall Jr. left in a walking boot with an ankle sprain. Kalia Davis and Elgton Jenkins are both due for evaluations, and Dillon Gabriel can open his 21-day practice window this week.

stories.title: Ryan Day gives injury update as No. 5 Ohio State preps for Maryland
stories.summary: Speaking Tuesday before the Buckeyes host Maryland on Saturday, Day addressed the health of his roster after a 31-14 win over Iowa that moved Ohio State to 4-1. The Maryland game is the last tune-up before a trip to Indiana the following week.

stories.title: Ohio State turns the page to Maryland after 31-14 win over Iowa
stories.summary: Ryan Day met the media at noon Tuesday to recap the Buckeyes' win over Iowa and preview Saturday's home game against Mike Locksley's Maryland. Kickoff in Ohio Stadium is set for 4:15 p.m. ET on Oct. 10.

stories.title: Day: Buckeyes freshmen must earn their snaps
stories.summary: At his weekly press conference ahead of Ohio State's Week 6 matchup with Maryland, Ryan Day said young players need to prove themselves in practice before getting game reps. The comments come as the Buckeyes manage a deep rotation on both sides of the ball.

stories.title: Red Bull still hunting the cause of Hadjar's lost Sepang podium
stories.summary: Team boss Laurent Mekies said Red Bull has no exact answer yet for why Isack Hadjar lost pace after the final safety car in Malaysia and slipped from third to fifth, with data from the chassis and power unit still being analysed. Mekies also indicated the car may have suffered floor damage on the way to the grid.

stories.title: Antonelli cannot clinch the title in Singapore; Austin is earliest
stories.summary: Kimi Antonelli leads George Russell by 84 points with 183 still available, so even a perfect weekend at Marina Bay would leave the championship open. The earliest the Mercedes driver could be crowned is the United States Grand Prix in Austin on October 25.

stories.title: Russell set for back-of-the-grid start in Singapore after engine change
stories.summary: Mercedes has confirmed George Russell needs a new power unit at Marina Bay, pushing him past his season allocation and triggering a grid penalty for Sunday's race. The extra blow leaves him 84 points behind teammate Kimi Antonelli after his retirement in Malaysia.

stories.title: Tarkov 1.2.0.0 lands: PvE Prestige and a PMC bot overhaul
stories.summary: Battlestate Games shipped patch 1.2.0.0 after a five-to-seven-hour shutdown, bringing the long-awaited Prestige system to PvE with up to six levels and permanent rewards such as TarCoin, the NKVD Finka knife and a unique Gamma container. AI PMCs now spawn more often at key locations, carry faction-appropriate gear and can appear in the Labyrinth.

stories.title: EXFIL Brothers pairs veterans with new players for bonus XP
stories.summary: The new EXFIL Brothers program lets Operators at level 30 or above invite up to five Recruits whose accounts are less than seven days old, giving both sides a 5% XP bonus when they raid together. Rewards range from rubles, Bitcoins and cases for Recruits to TarCoin, posters and Hideout customisation for Operators.

stories.title: Servers return as players update to 1.2.0.0
stories.summary: Battlestate took both PvP and PvE offline at 3 a.m. EDT for the 1.2.0.0 install, with the game expected back between 1 and 3 p.m. BST. Players need to update through the Battlestate launcher, and the studio has warned that login queues and fresh bugs are likely in the first hours.

stories.title: Early voting opens across Ohio for the Nov. 3 election
stories.summary: In-person early voting began Tuesday at county boards of elections and runs through Nov. 1, with absentee ballots also going out to voters who requested them. Franklin County voters can cast ballots from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. through Friday, with expanded hours later in the month.

stories.title: Central Ohio wakes to its chilliest morning since May
stories.summary: Columbus bottomed out in the low 40s Tuesday, with outlying areas dipping into the 30s and patchy frost possible, the coolest start in 144 days. Sunny skies bring a high near 67 before a gradual warm-up later in the week.

stories.title: About a dozen new Ohio laws take effect
stories.summary: A batch of laws took effect Tuesday, including a requirement that drivers provide basic identifying information at traffic stops and new mandates for schools. The changes were passed in the previous legislative session and took effect 90 days after signing.
